title: MessageCompleted
description: A message is finished, with its content as blocks. It supersedes whatever the deltas of the same `messageId` accumulated — a client that missed a delta is made whole here.

promptedBy.description: Who sent it, on a `user` message. It is what lets the UI say "you sent this from your phone" instead of showing an authorless turn.

content.description: The blocks of the message, in order.

type.description: Block kind — `text`, `tool_use`, `tool_result` and whatever the SDK adds next. Not an enum on purpose: a published app has to survive a kind added after it shipped.
